story.title: Ciputat-made cheese stick, kentang kering and keripik bawang for retail, hampers and everyday snacking.
story.body: DANISCAKELICIO is publicly listed in PFpreneur 2026 under Nani Mulyani. Its Shopee store and Tangsel Market listings show three core lines: cheese stick, kentang kering and keripik bawang, with public retail listings from Ciputat.
